title: Why Russia Is Exporting So Much Vaccine

sentences.en: When Russia developed a vaccine against COVID-19, it prioritized exporting it to dozens of foreign countries at the expense of its own people.
sentences.zh: 当俄罗斯开发出一种新冠肺炎疫苗时，它优先将疫苗出口到几十个外国，而牺牲了自己人民的利益。

sentences.en: Sabrina Tavernisi spoke with our colleague,
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西与我们的同事

sentences.en: Andrew Kramer, about how Russia is attempting to use its vaccine to improve its strength and standing on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·克雷默进行了交谈，探讨了俄罗斯如何试图利用其疫苗来提升其在世界舞台上的实力和地位。

sentences.en: It's Monday, April 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月26日，星期一。

sentences.en: Andrew.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁。

sentences.en: Sabrina, hello.
sentences.zh: 萨布丽娜，你好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: So why are we talking about Russia and vaccines?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们为什么要谈论俄罗斯和疫苗？

sentences.en: Well, this came as a surprise to, I think, a lot of people in 2020 when the pandemic began.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这在2020年大流行开始时让很多人感到意外。

sentences.en: The Russian government is saying it's on track to approve a coronavirus vaccine in August, well ahead of other countries, including the U.S., the U.K.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府表示，它有望在8月份批准一种冠状病毒疫苗，远远领先于包括美国、英国在内的其他国家。

sentences.en: Russia very quickly announced that it was developing a vaccine against the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯非常迅速地宣布正在开发一种对抗冠状病毒的疫苗。

sentences.en: The sheer speed at which Russian scientists have been able to develop this vaccine has raised a lot of eyebrows across the world.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯科学家开发这种疫苗的惊人速度引起了世界各地的广泛关注。

sentences.en: There was skepticism.
sentences.zh: 人们持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: There was certainly the feeling that that's not likely to be much of a success given the disorganized state of Russian science.
sentences.zh: 鉴于俄罗斯科学界的混乱状态，人们当然觉得这不太可能会取得多大的成功。

sentences.en: But by the middle of the year, they had already announced a working vaccine.
sentences.zh: 但到了年中，他们就已经宣布研发出了有效的疫苗。

sentences.en: Russia's Sputnik vaccine is
sentences.zh: 根据制造商的数据，俄罗斯的“卫星”疫苗

sentences.en: 91.4 percent effective, according to the manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 有效率为91.4%。

sentences.en: It's got emergency clearance in 15 nations.
sentences.zh: 它已获得15个国家的紧急使用授权。

sentences.en: If you look at the history, though, it's less of a surprise.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你看一下历史，就会发现这没那么令人意外。

sentences.en: Tell me about the history.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲这段历史吧。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, the story really starts in the aftermath of World War I, when the Soviet Union encountered quite a lot of infectious disease throughout its territory.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这个故事其实始于第一次世界大战之后，当时苏联在其领土上面临着相当多的传染病。

sentences.en: One of the main focuses was confronting the bubonic plague.
sentences.zh: 主要重点之一是对抗腺鼠疫。

sentences.en: It seems like a ghost from the Middle Ages, but this was actually a serious problem in the Soviet Union in the 1920s.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是中世纪的幽灵，但实际上这是20世纪20年代苏联的一个严重问题。

sentences.en: And the country set up what were called sanitary epidemiological stations, the equivalent of the CDC in the United States.
sentences.zh: 该国设立了所谓的卫生流行病站，相当于美国的疾控中心。

sentences.en: They were field stations to detect and contain infectious diseases.
sentences.zh: 它们是用于检测和控制传染病的野外工作站。

sentences.en: There was a lot of resources put into this.
sentences.zh: 这投入了大量资源。

sentences.en: And by the 1930s,
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪30年代，

sentences.en: Soviet effort to control infectious diseases had really focused on vaccines.
sentences.zh: 苏联控制传染病的努力真正集中在了疫苗上。

sentences.en: And by the end of this decade, the Soviet Union was a global leader in virology and vaccine development.
sentences.zh: 到这个十年末，苏联已成为病毒学和疫苗开发领域的全球领导者。

sentences.en: But it was not alone.
sentences.zh: 但它并不孤单。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: had also been through the Spanish flu and had been forced to develop expertise in
sentences.zh: 也经历过西班牙大流感，并被迫在疫苗方面培养专业知识

sentences.en: vaccines and was making strides in this science so that both the Soviet Union and the United States were very proficient in vaccine development.
sentences.zh: 并在这项科学上取得进展，使得苏联和美国在疫苗开发方面都非常熟练。

sentences.en: So these two countries were the global leaders in vaccines?
sentences.zh: 所以这两个国家是全球疫苗的领导者？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Particularly coming out of World War II, the Soviet Union and the United States were the global leaders in vaccine science.
sentences.zh: 特别是在二战之后，苏联和美国是疫苗科学领域的全球领导者。

sentences.en: And the real concern in the late 1940s was polio.
sentences.zh: 20世纪40年代末真正的担忧是小儿麻痹症。

sentences.en: This year, the enemy, poliomyelitis, struck with such impact and fury that it shook the entire nation.
sentences.zh: 今年，敌人——脊髓灰质炎——以如此巨大的冲击力和怒火袭来，震撼了整个国家。

sentences.en: Polio was the most frightening disease around.
sentences.zh: 小儿麻痹症是最令人可怕的疾病。

sentences.en: It has closed the gates on normal childhood.
sentences.zh: 它给正常的童年画上了句号。

sentences.en: It has swept our beaches, stilled our boats, and emptied our parks.
sentences.zh: 它席卷了我们的海滩，让我们的船只停驶，让我们的公园空无一人。

sentences.en: It was the number one killer of children, and it had spread rapidly after the chaos of World War II.
sentences.zh: 它是儿童的第一大杀手，在第二次世界大战的混乱之后迅速蔓延。

sentences.en: There has been no escape, no immunity, for this is epidemic.
sentences.zh: 对于这场流行病，无处可逃，也毫无免疫力。

sentences.en: There were devastating polio outbreaks in the United States, as well as in the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 美国和苏联都爆发了毁灭性的小儿麻痹症。

sentences.en: By the mid-1950s, the Soviet Union was reporting about 22,000 polio cases a year, which was about one-third of the level of polio in the United States, but was still
sentences.zh: 到20世纪50年代中期，苏联报告的脊髓灰质炎病例约为每年22,000起，约为美国水平的三分之一，但仍然是

sentences.en: a tremendous problem and something that was very frightening to parents because it was an incurable disease and very often resulted in paralysis and sometimes in death.
sentences.zh: 一个极其严重的问题，让父母感到非常恐惧，因为它是不治之症，往往会导致瘫痪，有时甚至会死亡。

sentences.en: So, by the 1950s, both the Soviet Union and the United States were experiencing really serious polio outbreaks.
sentences.zh: 因此，到20世纪50年代，苏联和美国都经历了非常严重的小儿麻痹症疫情。

sentences.en: So, what was the relationship between the two countries at the time?
sentences.zh: 那么，当时两国之间的关系如何？

sentences.en: Well, it was complicated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很复杂。

sentences.en: Looking at Russia, we might see it as a country to be studied.
sentences.zh: 审视俄罗斯，我们可能会将其视为一个需要研究的国家。

sentences.en: Yet, we know that Russia today is regarded as a grave threat to our nation.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们知道今天的俄罗斯被视为对我们国家的严重威胁。

sentences.en: This was the beginning of the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 这是冷战的开始。

sentences.en: The two countries were at odds, really, everywhere you looked.
sentences.zh: 事实上，无论你看到哪里，两国都处于对立状态。

sentences.en: Berlin, powder keg of Europe, saw a mass demonstration of indoctrinated young Germans on
sentences.zh: 欧洲的火药桶柏林，上演了被灌输思想的德国青年在

sentences.en: May Day.
sentences.zh: 五一劳动节的大规模游行。

sentences.en: And across the world in Japan, America's stronghold in the Pacific, the busy Kame's were at it again.
sentences.zh: 而在远在世界的日本——美国在太平洋的据点，忙碌的卡梅斯又开始行动了。

sentences.en: There was military competition in Eastern Europe and in Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 东欧和东南亚存在着军事竞争。

sentences.en: This first satellite was today successfully launched in the USSR.
sentences.zh: 今天，第一颗人造卫星在苏联成功发射。

sentences.en: The space race was just getting started at this time in the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代，太空竞赛正是在这个时候刚刚开始。

sentences.en: On every continent and in every land, the story of Sputnik 1 dominated the front pages.
sentences.zh: 在各大洲和各个土地上，“斯普特尼克1号”的故事占据了头版头条。

sentences.en: The Soviets had scored a scientific firSt. It is a challenge that President Eisenhower has said,
sentences.zh: 苏联取得了科学上的第一。艾森豪威尔总统曾表示，这是一个挑战

sentences.en: America must meet to survive in the space age.
sentences.zh: 美国必须迎接这一挑战，才能在太空时代生存下去。

sentences.en: And there really wasn't a whole lot of cooperation at all at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，其实根本没有多少合作。

sentences.en: So, the Soviet Union and the United States are really at odds.
sentences.zh: 因此，苏联和美国确实处于对立状态。

sentences.en: We're at the beginning of the
sentences.zh: 我们正处于

sentences.en: Cold War.
sentences.zh: 冷战的初期。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, polio is spreading really fast in both countries.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，小儿麻痹症在两国迅速蔓延。

sentences.en: So, how do these two governments respond?
sentences.zh: 那么，这两个政府是如何应对的呢？

sentences.en: So, the first vaccination efforts were carried out in the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，最初的疫苗接种工作是在美国进行的。

sentences.en: There was an attempt to use, killed, inactivated polio.
sentences.zh: 人们曾试图使用死病毒、灭活的小儿麻痹症疫苗。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, there was a bad batch of this polio vaccine, which infected hundreds of children in the United States and killed some of them
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，这批小儿麻痹症疫苗有一批质量很差，感染了美国数百名儿童并导致其中一些人死亡

sentences.en: and created a lot of vaccine skepticism and also realization that this approach to polio vaccine
sentences.zh: 并引发了对疫苗的大量怀疑，同时也让人意识到这种小儿麻痹症疫苗的方法

sentences.en: may not be the best and there might be a better way using a more modern technology, which was a weakened virus.
sentences.zh: 可能不是最好的，使用更现代的技术（即减毒病毒）可能会有更好的方法。

sentences.en: But the problem was that this would require giving a live polio virus to children.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，这需要给儿童注射活的小儿麻痹症病毒。

sentences.en: And there was nobody really in the United States who wanted to run this experiment.
sentences.zh: 美国真的没有人愿意进行这项实验。

sentences.en: And that's because there had been this botched experiment in which children actually died.
sentences.zh: 这是因为之前有过一次失败的实验，导致儿童实际死亡。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it was even more frightening to give your child a live polio virus as opposed to something that had been inactivated or supposedly inactivated.
sentences.zh: 与灭活或据称灭活的物质相比，给孩子注射活的小儿麻痹症病毒更令人恐惧。

sentences.en: So, while the technology was developed in the United States, there just was no way to test this in the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然这项技术是在美国开发的，但根本没有办法在美国进行测试。

sentences.en: What about the Soviet Union?
sentences.zh: 苏联呢？

sentences.en: What is it doing?
sentences.zh: 它在做什么？

sentences.en: Well, in the late 1950s, a Soviet delegation traveled to the United States, led by a husband and wife team of virologists, Mikhail Chumakov and Maria Varashilova.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在20世纪50年代末，一个苏联代表团访问了美国，由病毒学家夫妇米哈伊尔·丘马科夫和玛丽亚·瓦拉希洛娃率领。

sentences.en: And they visited with American scientists and asked for a sample of this new polio vaccine to bring back to the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 他们拜访了美国科学家，并索取了一份这种新脊髓灰质炎疫苗的样本带回苏联。

sentences.en: Now, the American scientists sought permission.
sentences.zh: 现在，美国科学家寻求批准。

sentences.en: They approached the State Department and the FBI, which provided approval for exporting essentially a brand new medical invention to the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 他们接洽了国务院和联邦调查局，后者批准将一种全新的医疗发明出口到苏联。

sentences.en: According to a study of this exchange, the Defense Department raised objections that the Soviets might use it to develop a germ warfare program.
sentences.zh: 根据对这次交流的研究，国防部提出了反对意见，认为苏联可能会利用它来开发细菌战计划。

sentences.en: But ultimately, the decision was made that this could be provided to the scientists, there could be scientific cooperation between the two countries.
sentences.zh: 但最终，双方做出决定，可以向科学家提供这些物资，两国之间可以进行科学合作。

sentences.en: And the live polio vaccine sample was carried to the Soviet
sentences.zh: 据记载，活的小儿麻痹症疫苗样本被装在米哈伊尔·丘马科夫的口袋里带到了苏联

sentences.en: Union by one account in the pocket of Mikhail Chumakov.
sentences.zh: 通过米哈伊尔·丘马科夫掌控的一个账户进行联合。

sentences.en: In the pocket?
sentences.zh: 在口袋里？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was more casual, perhaps, than it would be done today.
sentences.zh: 也许比现在更随意一些。

sentences.en: This was a potentially risky live virus.
sentences.zh: 这是一种潜在危险的活病毒。

sentences.en: The Soviet scientist brought it to his laboratory for infectious disease, tested it, determined that it would probably be safe and effective.
sentences.zh: 苏联科学家将其带到他的传染病实验室，进行了测试，确定它可能是安全且有效的。

sentences.en: But then there was the next step that had to be taken.
sentences.zh: 但接下来还有下一步要走。

sentences.en: This had to be tested on children.
sentences.zh: 这必须在儿童身上进行测试。

sentences.en: So what does Chumakov do?
sentences.zh: 那么丘马科夫做了什么？

sentences.en: So in Soviet medicine, there was a tradition that the inventor of a new technique or a new medicine
sentences.zh: 所以在苏联医学界，有一个传统，即新技术的发明者或新药的发明者

sentences.en: should try this on himself firSt. So he discusses this with his wife, who's also a virologist,
sentences.zh: 应该首先在自己身上尝试这一点。于是他与同样是病毒学家的妻子进行了讨论，

sentences.en: and they decide that they will provide the live polio vaccine to their own young children on sugar cubes.
sentences.zh: 他们决定将活的小儿麻痹症疫苗放在方糖上喂给他们自己的年幼孩子。

sentences.en: Wow, that's incredible.
sentences.zh: 哇，太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Their own children?
sentences.zh: 他们自己的孩子？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this experiment was carried out in a Moscow apartment in the late 1950s.
sentences.zh: 这项实验是20世纪50年代末在莫斯科的一间公寓里进行的。

sentences.en: They had their own children line up and provided them with the sugar cubes with a drop of live polio virus on them and then watched to see what would happen.
sentences.zh: 他们让自己的孩子排好队，给他们吃滴有一滴活脊髓灰质炎病毒的方糖，然后观察会发生什么。

sentences.en: And what did happen?
sentences.zh: 结果怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, thankfully, nothing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢天谢地，什么事也没有。

sentences.en: It was the safe vaccine.
sentences.zh: 这是一种安全的疫苗。

sentences.en: They did not develop polio.
sentences.zh: 他们没有患上小儿麻痹症。

sentences.en: What they did develop was immunity to polio because the virus was weakened and this was an effective vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们产生的是对小儿麻痹症的免疫力，因为病毒被削弱了，这是一种有效的疫苗。

sentences.en: They took their findings based on this experiment on their own children to senior officials in the Soviet government.
sentences.zh: 他们根据在自己孩子身上做实验的结果，向苏联政府的高级官员汇报了他们的发现。

sentences.en: And as a next step, they tested the vaccine on orphans in the Baltic states in Estonia and Latvia and
sentences.zh: 作为下一步，他们在波罗的海国家爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和

sentences.en: Lithuania.
sentences.zh: 立陶宛的孤儿身上测试了该疫苗。

sentences.en: There was a large polio outbreak in this area, and this was going to be the solution to the problem.
sentences.zh: 该地区爆发了大规模的脊髓灰质炎疫情，这将是解决问题的方案。

sentences.en: And it was a gamble that paid off.
sentences.zh: 这是一个得到回报的赌博。

sentences.en: By 1959, they had begun mass vaccinations.
sentences.zh: 到1959年，他们已经开始大规模接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And in 1960, they vaccinated every person in the Soviet Union between the ages of two months and 20 years old.
sentences.zh: 1960年，他们为苏联境内所有年龄在两个月到20岁之间的人接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: At the time, it was the fastest mass vaccination ever carried out, and they eliminated polio.
sentences.zh: 在当时，这是有史以来进行的最快的大规模疫苗接种，他们消灭了小儿麻痹症。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And what about the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 美国呢？

sentences.en: Does it start using the new polio vaccine, too?
sentences.zh: 它也开始使用新的小儿麻痹症疫苗了吗？

sentences.en: So the United States authorities agreed to approve this vaccine in the United States in 1962.
sentences.zh: 因此，美国当局于1962年同意在美国批准这种疫苗。

sentences.en: The Medical Officer of Health set the target.
sentences.zh: 卫生医疗官设定了目标。

sentences.zh: 此外，该疫苗未获欧洲监管机构批准。

sentences.en: So this was creating discord within the European Union.
sentences.zh: 因此，这在欧盟内部造成了不和。

sentences.en: And creating discord within the European Union has been a longtime goal of Russian diplomacy.
sentences.zh: 在欧盟内部制造不和一直是俄罗斯外交的长期目标。

sentences.en: And in this case, it was aided with the use of the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，疫苗的使用助推了这一目标的实现。

sentences.en: But it's gone beyond that as well.
sentences.zh: 但情况还不止于此。

sentences.en: The Russians have signed contracts with one region in Italy and with the state of Bavaria in Germany.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯已与意大利的一个大区以及德国的巴伐利亚州签署了合同。

sentences.en: So they're winning customers now in the very heart of Europe.
sentences.zh: 所以他们现在正在欧洲腹地赢得客户。

sentences.en: Yeah, these are core bloc states of the EU.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些都是欧盟的核心成员国。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in countries that have been accepting the Russian vaccine, polls show that people trust it more than even vaccines made in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在接受俄罗斯疫苗的国家中，民意调查显示，人们对它的信任度甚至超过了美国制造的疫苗。

sentences.en: For example, in Argentina and Mexico, polls have shown that more people trust the Russian-made Sputnik V vaccine than American-made vaccines.
sentences.zh: 例如，在阿根廷和墨西哥，民意调查显示，更多人信任俄罗斯制造的“卫星V”疫苗，而不是美国制造的疫苗。

sentences.en: That's surprising.
sentences.zh: 这真令人意外。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it's been quite a benefit to Russia's image around the world.
sentences.zh: 而且这对俄罗斯在世界范围内的形象大有裨益。

sentences.en: Wherever we look in Russia's vaccine diplomacy, it's been quite effective politically and in terms of PR.
sentences.zh: 无论我们怎么看俄罗斯的疫苗外交，它在政治和公关方面都非常有效。

sentences.en: At the cost of, in fact, very small shipments of vaccine.
sentences.zh: 而代价实际上只是运送了少量的疫苗。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: For example, only tens of thousands of doses were sent to Bolivia in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 例如，只向拉丁美洲的玻利维亚发送了几万剂疫苗。

sentences.en: Bolivian President Luis Arce has signed a contract for the supply of the Sputnik V vaccine to fight COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 玻利维亚总统路易斯·阿尔塞已签署合同，采购“卫星V”疫苗以抗击新冠肺炎。

sentences.en: And yet the president of the country came to the airport to meet the airplane that delivered them.
sentences.zh: 然而该国总统却亲自去机场迎接运送疫苗的飞机。

sentences.en: Sometimes very small numbers of doses are sent to places that will seem to have a high impact of media coverage.
sentences.zh: 有时，极少剂量的疫苗会被发送到那些能产生巨大媒体曝光度的地方。

sentences.en: While the rest of Europe is still struggling with the vaccination campaign, the tiny Republic of San Marino is on its way to immunize most of its citizens.
sentences.zh: 正当欧洲其他国家仍在与疫苗接种运动作斗争时，微小的圣马力共和国正迈向为其大多数公民接种疫苗的目标。

sentences.en: For example, in a stunt, Russia vaccinated the entire nation of San Marino with a population of 7,000 people.
sentences.zh: 例如，通过一场作秀，俄罗斯为拥有七千人口的整个圣马力诺国家接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: Thanks also to the use of Sputnik V, Russia's vaccine.
sentences.zh: 这也多亏了俄罗斯疫苗“卫星V”的使用。

sentences.en: So the numbers have been quite small, but they've had a very large impact politically.
sentences.zh: 因此，数量虽然很少，但它们在政治上产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: So, Andrew, in a way, this is making me think of how Russia has been acting ever since the Soviet Union collapsed.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁，从某种意义上说，这让我想起了自苏联解体以来俄罗斯的行为方式。

sentences.en: I mean, trying again and again on the world stage to prove it is still powerful, to prove it is still important.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它在世界舞台上一再试图证明自己仍然强大，证明自己仍然重要。

sentences.en: And these vaccines are a way to show that.
sentences.zh: 而这些疫苗就是展现这一点的一种方式。

sentences.en: It also shows it in a different way than what we usually think of Russia, when we think of Russia asserting its influence.
sentences.zh: 它还以一种不同于我们以往对俄罗斯伸张影响力时的刻板印象的方式展现了这一点。

sentences.en: Typically, Russia is seen as a villain when it sends troops into a neighboring country like Ukraine or assassins abroad to target enemies.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，当俄罗斯向乌克兰这样的邻国派遣军队或向海外派遣刺客去针对敌人时，它被视为一个恶棍。

sentences.en: But in the story of vaccines, Russia has really been a savior.
sentences.zh: 但在疫苗的故事中，俄罗斯确实成了救世主。

sentences.en: It's been able to present itself as a country that's helping the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 它把自己塑造成了一个正在帮助世界其他国家的国家。

sentences.en: And in this way, it's a form of influence, which is very difficult for the West to counter, for the West to stand up againSt.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，这形成了一种影响力，西方很难对此进行反制，很难与之抗衡。

sentences.en: And when the pandemic is over, it's likely that Russia will emerge because of this vaccine diplomacy
sentences.zh: 当大流行结束时，俄罗斯很可能会因为这场疫苗外交而崭露头角

sentences.en: as a country with more friends and allies than it would have had had it not pursued this course.
sentences.zh: 成为一个拥有更多朋友和盟友的国家，如果不走这条路的话，它本不会有这么多朋友和盟友。

sentences.en: Thank you, Andrew.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，安德鲁。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So far, Russia has manufactured about 20 million doses of its COVID-19 vaccine.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，俄罗斯已经生产了大约2000万剂新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: Of those, it has exported about 4 million doses, or one-fifth, to foreign countries, instead of using them on Russians.
sentences.zh: 其中，它向外国出口了大约400万剂，也就是五分之一，而不是将它们用在俄罗斯人身上。

sentences.en: As of this past weekend, Russia has fully vaccinated just 5% of its people.
sentences.zh: 截至上周末，俄罗斯仅为其5%的人口完全接种了疫苗。

sentences.en: By comparison, the United States has fully vaccinated 27%.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，美国已经完全接种了27%。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, President Biden recognized the mass killings of Armenians more than a century ago
sentences.zh: 上周末，拜登总统承认了一个多世纪前针对亚美尼亚人的大屠杀

sentences.en: as a genocide, something never before done by an American president for fear of offending Turkey, which denies that the killings amounted to a genocide.
sentences.zh: 是一场种族灭绝，这是美国总统此前从未做过的事，因为担心冒犯土耳其，而土耳其否认这些杀戮构成了种族灭绝。

sentences.en: The killings of Armenians occurred at the end of World War I, during the collapse of the Ottoman Empire, which later became Turkey.
sentences.zh: 对亚美尼亚人的杀戮发生在第一次世界大战结束时，正值奥斯曼帝国崩塌之际，该帝国后来成为了土耳其。

sentences.en: Ottoman Turks feared that Armenians would become allies with Russia, an enemy of the Ottoman Turks,
sentences.zh: 奥斯曼土耳其人担心亚美尼亚人会成为奥斯曼土耳其人的敌人俄罗斯的盟友，

sentences.en: and began forced deportations and killings of Armenians to avoid that possibility.
sentences.zh: 并开始强行驱逐和杀害亚美尼亚人以避免这种可能性。

sentences.en: In the end, as many as 1.5 million Armenians were killed.
sentences.zh: 最终，多达150万亚美尼亚人被杀害。

sentences.en: In response to Biden's declaration, Turkey's government vowed to defend itself against what it called a lie.
sentences.zh: 作为对拜登声明的回应，土耳其政府誓言要捍卫自己，反对其所谓的谎言。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rochelle Banja, Rachel Quester, Alexandra Lee Young, and Leslie Davis.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗谢尔·班贾、雷切尔·奎斯特、亚历山德拉·李·扬和莱斯利·戴维斯制作。

sentences.zh: 由M.J.

sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩和丽莎·周剪辑，克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就一直陷入一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。
